question: True or false: a file that only exports data, like quotes.js, appears in the module dependency tree.
say: True or false: a file that only exports data, like quotes dot js, appears in the module dependency tree.
explanation: True. The dependency tree has every imported module, components or not. The render tree only has components.
explainSay: True. Every imported module is in the dependency tree. Only the render tree is limited to components.
